availability.message: Six species: existing Human/Ratling paths plus level-one Ogryn Skullbreaker, Skitarii Veteran, Kin Armsman/Hernkyn and Aeldari Outcast in their certified NORMAL Origins. Twitchy and explicitly reviewed package/choice branches only. Human Veterans may explicitly upgrade from v4 at level 3 for level-four ASI/Talent advancement.
Rare Origins require trusted GM approval and are unavailable for self-service creation.
Limited Origins require combination-specific campaign approval and are unavailable for self-service creation.
Non-Human higher levels, psychic paths, unmapped tool/vehicle choices and unreviewed equipment remain unavailable. Magna-rail requires trusted GM approval. Prior snapshots remain unchanged.

blockedEquipmentOptions.message: Hernkyn starting Magna-rail Rifle explicitly requires GM approval; no self-service approval exists.

di.species.ogryn.message: Only these reviewed Ogryn-frame starting items are certified; other fit/modification contexts require review.

options.benefit:
Talent: Armour Familiarity
Benefit: While wearing armour you are proficient with, reduce incoming damage from non-critical weapon attacks by 1.
options.label: Armour Familiarity
options.note: Incoming conditional reduction is manual; no automated target damage.

options.benefit:
Talent: Bayonet Fighter
Benefit: When wielding a basic firearm in two hands, you may make a 1d6 piercing melee attack with it.
options.label: Bayonet Fighter
options.note: Conditional basic-firearm melee mode is manual; no invented proficiency or attack formula.

options.benefit:
Talent: Brawler
Benefit: Your unarmed strikes deal 1d6 damage, or 1d8 if both hands are free.
options.label: Brawler
options.note: Hand-dependent unarmed damage remains manual; no baseline weapon changes.

options.benefit:
Talent: Breacher
Benefit: You have advantage on checks to force doors, smash barricades, and breach weak bulkheads. Your first attack against an object deals +1d8 damage.
options.label: Breacher
options.note: Object/terrain benefits are contextual and manual.

options.benefit:
Talent: Close-Quarters Killer
Benefit: You do not suffer disadvantage when making ranged attacks within 5 ft.
options.label: Close-Quarters Killer
options.note: Contextual disadvantage exception is manually applied.

options.benefit:
Talent: Combat Medic
Benefit: As an action, restore 1d6 + proficiency bonus HP to an adjacent creature. Uses equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.
options.label: Combat Medic
options.note: Healing targets and uses are manually tracked; new resource has explicit full initial uses.

options.benefit:
Talent: Crisis Runner
Benefit: When you Dash, difficult terrain caused by rubble, crowds, gantries, wreckage, or industrial clutter costs no extra movement.
options.label: Crisis Runner
options.note: Conditional Dash terrain exception is manual.

options.benefit:
Talent: Field Armourer
Benefit: During a short rest, repair one damaged weapon or restore one use of a shield, field, or armour feature at the GM's discretion.
options.label: Field Armourer
options.note: Source explicitly leaves the repair/restoration to the GM.

options.benefit:
Talent: Heavy Weapon Training
Benefit: You ignore the movement penalty from Heavy weapons.
options.label: Heavy Weapon Training
options.note: Contextual movement penalty exception is manual.

options.benefit:
Talent: Hip Fire
Benefit: After moving at least 10 ft, make one pistol attack as a bonus action.
options.label: Hip Fire
options.note: Conditional bonus-action permission; resolve the qualifying movement manually.

options.benefit:
Talent: Hive-Blooded
Requirement: Human or Ratling
Benefit: You have advantage on checks to navigate hive districts, underhive markets, vents, hab-blocks, sump routes, and gang territory.
options.label: Hive-Blooded
options.note: Structured Human-or-Ratling requirement; contextual navigation advantage is manual.

options.benefit:
Talent: Iron Discipline
Benefit: Advantage on saving throws against fear and Suppression.
options.label: Iron Discipline
options.note: Source-specific fear benefit; no global condition or stacking policy.

options.benefit:
Talent: Point Blank Execution
Benefit: Once per short rest, when you hit a target within 5 ft with a pistol or shotgun, add 1d6 damage.
options.label: Point Blank Execution
options.note: Conditional extra die is manual, with one short-rest use.

options.benefit:
Talent: Rapid Reload
Benefit: Reload basic weapons as a bonus action instead of an action.
options.label: Rapid Reload
options.note: Reload timing is manual; no inventory/ammunition automation.

options.benefit:
Talent: Relic-Bearer
Benefit: You carry a minor relic, oath-token, saint bone, engraved casing, or machine charm. Once per long rest, add 1d4 to a saving throw after seeing the roll.
options.label: Relic-Bearer
options.note: Manual saving-throw die and source flavour item; one long-rest use.

options.benefit:
Talent: Tactical Reposition
Benefit: When you take the Disengage action, one ally within 5 ft may move 5 ft without provoking opportunity attacks.
options.label: Tactical Reposition
options.note: Conditional ally movement is manual.

Talent: Weapon Specialist
Benefit: Choose one weapon group: pistols, basic firearms, sniper weapons, shotguns, chain weapons, shock weapons, plasma, melta, or heavy weapons. Gain +1 damage with that group.
options.label: Weapon Specialist — pistol
options.note: Source-listed weapon-group choice; standalone +1 weapon damage is calculated. Ambiguous combined stacking remains manual (PHB-RULE-058).
